people.imagined: Evening in the moulting loft. She has just pressed a thumb to a freshly inked feather roll and is checking the mark against the light from the slats. The hundredth socket in her fan is empty and she has decided, again, that it will stay empty.
people.subject: The moment: late afternoon in a moonlit feather loft, she holds a long brown feather up between two fingers of her left hand and studies it with one eye narrowed, while her ink-black right thumb is held up near her cheek. Face (most important: the ink-stained thumb must read large): a broad calm face, skin warm olive, a few fine lines at the eyes, level dark brows, a straight short nose, a small patient mouth. Her right thumb is stained solid black to the first knuckle. Hair: black with a little grey at the temples, in a low knot pinned by a carved white-jade hairpin shaped like a feather. Body: small, solid, rounded shoulders, a slight forward lean over her work. Clothing: a leaf-green inner robe of silk with a russet second collar, over it a gauze over-robe in russet that falls in wide folds, and a capelet of overlapping moulted feathers in tan, brown and slate-blue lying like scales on her shoulders; collars embroidered with tiny gold birds; a sash with a jade pendant and tassel. Hands and objects: a half-open round fan in her lap fitted with eighty-one feathers of many kinds, one empty socket at its edge plainly showing as a gap; a short stack of paper rolls tied with cord. Power: a few soft green motes of wood qi drift up from the feathers and settle in the fan. Background: dark wooden loft slats in mist, bunches of drying feathers glowing faintly. Light: silvery spirit-light slanting from the upper left through the slats, a soft green rim light along her hair. Expression: a stubborn, patient face with one eye narrowed and a quiet, unhurried set to the mouth.

people.imagined: Pre-dawn, his bags packed, standing at the loft door at Hà Loan. A small bird is on his shoulder facing the milky eye, which is how he likes it: it does the looking on that side. He is listening to the rain end.
people.subject: The moment: at a loft door in blue pre-dawn mist, an old aviary hand turns his head so that his clouded left eye faces the viewer, while a small olive-and-yellow bird sits on his left shoulder facing the same way. Face (most important: the clouded eye): a long, lined, sun-browned face; the LEFT eye is entirely milky blue-white with no dark pupil, the right eye is clear brown; thick white eyebrows; a long nose with a flattened tip; a thin straight mouth, short white stubble. Hair: thinning white hair tied in a small knot at the back with a plain silver pin, a few loose wisps. Body: tall, narrow, stooped, big knuckled. Clothing: flowing robes of faded moss-green silk with a russet second collar and wide sleeves mended with matching thread, over them a feather mantle of brown and grey moulted feathers, its left shoulder worn smooth where the bird perches; a gold-thread bird embroidered at the collar; a strap across the chest holding a small travel pack, a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: his right hand is held out palm up with a few seeds in it, a second plain grey bird pecking at them. Power: a faint thread of green wood qi curls around the birds. Background: dark aviary bars in drifting mist, a dim lantern, wet leaves. Light: cool blue dawn glow from the upper left with a warm pinpoint from the lantern and a soft silver rim on his white hair. Expression: a calm, amused face with a faint crease of a smile, lids lowered as if listening to the rain end.

people.imagined: Midday on a cinnamon-wood path. She has stopped to rest and the birds have come down without being asked: three on her head, one on each shoulder. She is trying not to laugh in case it scares them.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a mossy log in a cinnamon wood at dusk, she holds herself very still with a barely contained grin while five small birds perch on her head and shoulders. Face: a round, open young face, brown skin with a scatter of freckles, big dark eyes bright with delight, short soft brows, a snub nose, a wide mouth pressed shut over a laugh, dimples. Hair: thick black, in two short plaits tied with green ribbons, three small bright birds settled on her crown (a green finch, a yellow warbler and a tiny blue one). Body: slender, young, shoulders hunched with held-in laughter. Clothing: simple graceful robes of pale leaf-green silk with a crossed collar and wide sleeves rolled once at the wrist, a short capelet of speckled brown feathers, a narrow russet sash; the collar edged with tiny golden birds. Hands and objects: in her lap a small round fan whose frame has four empty sockets, bare ribs showing and no feathers yet; a red-brown bird on her left shoulder and another on her right wrist. Power: a few pale green motes of wood qi float around the birds like fireflies. Background: dark cinnamon trunks in mist, drifting leaves, glimmers of light. Light: soft green-gold spirit-light from the upper left, leaf shadows on her cheek, a gentle glow rimming her plaits. Expression: a barely contained grin with pressed lips, cheeks pushed up and bright eyes shining, shoulders trembling with held-in laughter.

people.imagined: On an empty road at noon, post bag on his hip, he lifts the horn and blows a long note at nobody, then listens to the echo with his head tilted, pleased with it.
people.subject: The moment: on a pale road in a silvery noon-glow he puts a brass post horn to his lips and blows it at nothing, eyes closed, cheeks puffed. Face: a young, lean, quick face; tanned; a thin moustache of a few dark hairs; strong straight brows; sharp dark eyes (shut here); a long mobile mouth around the horn. Hair: black, short and tousled, held by a green silk headband with a small jade bead. Body: wiry, a messenger's build, tall and forward on the balls of the feet. Clothing: a leaf-green silk travelling robe with a russet second collar, narrow-cut for the road, its hem greyed with dust, a short cape of brown moulted feathers with a blue-black feather collar, a wide silk-and-leather bag across his chest closed with a brass buckle, a small plain brown bird perched on the strap. Hands and objects: a curved brass post horn in his right hand raised to his mouth; a fine gauntlet on his left forearm. The horn's flared bell catches a hard spark of light, and the small bird tilts its head at him with polite disbelief. Power: a ripple of faint green qi spreads from the horn's mouth like a sound made visible. Background: a pale road curling into dark green hills under drifting mist, a single milestone. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the upper left, a crisp rim along the cheek. Expression: a broad, cheeky grin pressed around the horn, brows lifted above the shut eyes, the delighted look of a man who thinks the road owes him for the noise.

people.imagined: At the fan bench in lamplight, binding a rib. The fan scorches in her hands again and she looks at it the way one looks at a dog that has done it again, then covers the mark with her thumb.
people.subject: The moment: at a workbench by lamplight, she ties the last cord on a practice fan and looks up sharply as a thread of smoke rises from the paper. Face (most important: the grey streak): a heart-shaped face, pale warm skin, grave dark eyes, firm thin brows, a small straight nose, a closed, guarded mouth; a clear streak of grey hair at the front of a black fringe, wide as two fingers, running from the part down to the left eyebrow. Hair: black, a straight fringe, the rest in a bun low on the neck, bound with a red silk cord and a silver pin. Body: slim, straight-backed, tense. Clothing: a fitted leaf-green silk robe with a russet inner collar and sleeves tied back with red cord for work, a vest of dark brown moulted feathers over it, a red thread at the collar, a narrow sash with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a half-bound fan of dark feathers on bamboo ribs held open before her, one rib charred black at its tip, with a thin curl of smoke; a coil of waxed cord over her wrist. Power: a tiny ember-red spark of fire qi flickers at the scorched tip and a faint red glint lives in her eyes, green wood qi motes drifting beside it. Background: dark workshop in haze, spools of thread, a row of finished fans hanging and glowing faintly. Light: warm lamplight from the left, the orange flicker at the tip, a soft silver rim on her hair. Expression: a shut, stubborn face with a tightened jaw and a sharp, annoyed glance, lips pressed against saying anything.

people.imagined: He is carrying a basket up a stairway of roots and has been asked a question he did not hear; he grins first, as always, and then asks for it again.
people.subject: The moment: halfway up a misty forest stair, a boy hauling a basket turns to the viewer with a wide grin and cups a hand behind one ear. Face: a round young face, sun-brown, wide-set dark eyes with raised brows, a broad flat nose, a big gap-toothed grin showing a missing front tooth, ears sticking out. A fine sheen of sweat shines on his forehead from the climb. Hair: black, cropped short and uneven as if cut with a knife, a tuft standing up at the back. Body: small, stocky, sturdy, bare forearms scratched. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple: a short robe of faded leaf-green silk with a crossed collar and plain sleeves pushed up, clean, a short cape of mottled brown feathers, a rope-and-silk belt; no ornaments. Hands and objects: a tall woven basket with a lid on his back held by a strap across his chest; a few pale wriggling grubs spilled on the lid; his left hand cupped to his ear. A small plain wren sits on the basket's rim. Background: a dark green slope with roots and stone steps, a thread of mist hanging low on the stair, motes of pale light between the roots. Light: soft dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a faint green glow on the leaves. Expression: an open, gap-toothed, eager grin, brows high and eyes wide, the face of a boy who will believe whatever he is told next.

people.imagined: Late afternoon on the loft steps with her notebook open on her knee, looking up at the sky because the birds have just gone quiet, and she is about to write it down.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a loft step at dusk with a pencil poised, she looks up at the sky over her open notebook, mouth a little open, as the birds have just gone quiet. Face: a narrow thoughtful young face, pale olive skin, large dark serious eyes under long lashes, thin level brows, a small nose with a pencil smudge on its tip, a small pursed mouth. Hair: black, straight, cut to the jaw with a side parting, one side tucked behind the ear and held by a small green jade clasp; a few fine strands have escaped and stick to her cheek. Body: thin, slightly hunched, narrow shoulders. Clothing: simple graceful robes of pale leaf-green silk with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves whose cuffs are ink-stained, a short capelet of brown feathers, a russet sash. Hands and objects: a thin cord around her neck carries a small cloth-covered notebook resting on her chest; a second notebook open on her knee showing rows of tiny drawn bird faces, no letters; a short pencil in her right hand, its point sharp, her fingers carrying a faint grey graphite shine. A silent grey sparrow sits on her shoulder. Background: dark loft rails in mist, a pale violet sky with a first star. Light: soft cool spirit-light, green shade with a gold edge from the upper left, a faint silver rim on her cheek. Expression: a held breath and a slightly open mouth, brows drawn level, eyes fixed on the silent sky with careful, patient concentration.

people.imagined: In the moulting loft at dusk, she has stopped mid-sentence to look at her fan. Feathers have gathered in her white hair and she does not know. She counts the ninety-nine again.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk in a bird loft, a stooped old woman holds a large open fan before her and counts its feathers with one finger, unaware of the many feathers nestled in her hair. Face: an old, soft, round face with deep fine wrinkles; faded brown eyes, warm and a little misted; thin pale brows; a small nose; a gentle, slightly open mouth. Hair: white, long, in a loose bun held by a jade hairpin, with at least seven small feathers of different colours stuck in it, a blue one, a red, a yellow and some brown. Body: short, stooped, a bent back and thin wrists. Clothing: an elder's long mantle of feathers in many browns and soft blues, very full and trailing, thick at the shoulders and crowned at the neck with a ruff of a hundred colours; under it layered robes of leaf-green and russet silk with three crossed collars, wide sleeves, gold-thread birds along every border; a silver-and-jade crown-comb in her hair, jade pendants and tassels at the sash. Hands and objects: a big round fan of ninety-nine feathers in distinct kinds, each differently coloured, spread in a wide round like a sunflower, one empty socket at the very top plainly visible as a dark gap; a blue magpie with one white wing feather perches on her left shoulder. Power: a gentle halo of green wood qi with slow drifting motes rises around the fan and mantle, strong and quiet. Background: dark roost poles hung with glowing feathers, mist. Light: low amber spirit-light from the upper left, soft green glow, silver rim on her white hair. Expression: a soft, tender, faraway face with parted lips and gentle eyes that drift past the viewer.

people.imagined: A seal in his fingers at his workbench: he has just closed a letter again and is pleased with the closing, grinning like a man who has won a hand of cards. A bird dropping on each shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: at a post-house table by candle-glow he lifts a freshly closed letter with a red wax seal between finger and thumb and grins at the viewer. Face: a wiry, lined, tanned face, a wide, sly, gap-toothed grin, quick amber eyes with crow's-feet, thin curved brows, a hooked nose, a short pointed goatee in black going grey. Hair: black and grey, a topknot bound with a green silk strip and a bronze pin, a few strands loose. Body: narrow and quick, stooped shoulders, leaning forward. Clothing: flowing deep-green silk robes with a russet second collar and sleeves rolled to the elbow, a cape of brown feathers with a blue-black collar and, plainly visible, white bird droppings on both shoulders; a wide sash hung with a row of small brass bells and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: the sealed letter held up in his right hand; on the table by his left, a thin steel knife and a spoon with a warm glowing tip; a grey post pigeon stands on his gauntleted forearm. Power: a faint green wisp of wood qi curls around the pigeon's feathers. Background: a dark wall of pigeonholes full of small rolled letters, a cage of grey birds, mist from the open door. Light: warm candlelight from the left, a pale silver rim light on his goatee. Expression: a sly, delighted grin with raised brows and gleaming eyes, relishing the move like a gambler with a winning hand.

people.imagined: She is inspecting a bundle of fans at the bench and has found a crooked rib. She holds the fan up to the light, one eyebrow raised, deciding whom to complain to.
people.subject: The moment: at a fan-maker's bench lit by brazier glow, she holds an open fan edge-on to her eye to sight along its ribs, one brow arched, and glares at the viewer over its top. Face: a broad, strong, weathered face; ruddy brown skin; a heavy jaw; sharp black eyes; thick arched brows, the left one raised; a wide, down-turned mouth; laugh lines turned to scowl lines. A sheen of sweat sits on her forehead and upper lip from the heat. Hair: black streaked with grey, pulled tightly into a high knot with two silver pins. Body: stout, broad-shouldered, strong forearms. Clothing: a well-cut rust-and-russet silk robe with two crossed collars, sleeves pushed up above the elbow, a sleeveless vest of dark brown feathers, collar embroidered with gold birds; a plain dark sash with a jade pendant; both bare forearms covered with rows of old pale-pink burn blisters and scars, clearly visible, many rows. Hands and objects: a half-bound fan of dark feathers with one visibly crooked rib in her left hand; a spool of waxed thread on a loop at the wrist. Power: ember-red motes of fire qi drift up from the brazier and a faint green wood glow lies on the feathers, the fire stronger. Background: dark shelves of unfinished fans and bundles of bamboo ribs in warm haze. Light: brazier-orange light from below left, a thin gold rim on her jaw. Expression: a heavy-lidded, imperious glare down her nose, one brow cocked and the mouth pulled down at the corners, the look of a woman who already knows the fan is at fault and is choosing whom to blame.

people.imagined: Asleep in the shade, hat over his eyes, hands folded, a row of sticky lime-sticks drying on a rack beside him. A bird has landed on his stomach and is not disturbed.
people.subject: The moment: a man dozing in the shade of a tree on a moonlit evening, hat tipped over his eyes, one hand lifted lazily to wave off a fly, with a small bird on his chest. Face: a broad, round, easy face, brown and creased, grey stubble, a large nose, a wide relaxed smile in his sleep, a slack lower lip. Both hands in view have a dull yellow-white lime paste on every fingertip, thick and clearly visible. A little drool of sleep shines at the corner of his mouth. Hair: grey, short, mostly hidden under a wide straw hat. Body: heavy, round-bellied, slumped against a trunk. Clothing: loose, faded leaf-green silk robes with a crossed collar open at the throat, a russet under-collar, a brown feather cape slung loosely over one shoulder, a plain cord sash; an outer disciple's ease, clean but unornamented. Hands and objects: in his lap a dozen thin bamboo lime-sticks tied with a string, their tips shining with sticky paste; a small woven cage beside him with a chirping finch. Power: a few drowsy green motes of wood qi float lazily above him. Background: dark leaf shade with mist, a rack of drying sticks leaning against the trunk, a patch of leaves glowing soft green. Light: dappled spirit-light from the upper left, silver-green, with a faint rim on his stubble. Expression: a slack, blissful half-smile with the jaw loose and the brows smooth, the face of a man who has never once been in a hurry.

people.imagined: Dawn in the hidden loft. She has whistled and nine red-crested birds come down to her arms, and she is so proud that she has not noticed the whistle has left a dent in her lip.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn inside a small dim loft, she has just whistled and red-crested birds have landed around her, some on her arms and shoulders and some on a perch before her; she looks at them with shining pride. Face (most important: the red dent in her lower lip): a pale, narrow, shy face; large dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; her lower lip carries a clear, deep red indent in its centre, the mark of the whistle, a round dent the size of a bean. Hair: black, long, in a simple braid over one shoulder tied with a red silk thread and a small silver bead. Body: slight, tall, standing very straight. Clothing: a clean jungle-green silk robe with two crossed collars and narrow sleeves, a dark-brown feather mantle with a deep-blue feather collar, gold-thread birds at the neckline; a small brass key on a cord at her chest and a jade pendant at the sash. Hands and objects: a thin bone whistle between two fingers of her right hand; both forearms in fine gauntlets with birds on them, birds with scarlet crests and brown backs. Power: tiny pale-green motes of wood qi circle the birds like a slow ring of light. Background: a small dim loft with a single high window, a wooden door in mist. Light: pale pink dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a soft silver rim on her braid. Expression: loyal, solitary, certain she has been given an honour.

people.imagined: Dusk on the ridge: she is mid-song, head thrown back, throat full, and the birds are streaming home above her. She is entirely at ease with how big her voice is, and she does not look at anyone below her.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a ridge she sings with head thrown back and chin raised, mouth wide open, as a dozen small post birds spiral in toward her raised arm. Face: an oval, striking young face; warm tan skin; a strong chin; large dark eyes half-closed; arched brows; a wide open mouth in song showing white teeth; a small pert nose. A flush of effort warms her cheeks and the tendons of her throat stand out as she sings. Hair: dark brown, long, loose and windblown, with a single orange feather and a silver hairpin set behind one ear. Body: sturdy and tall for her age, broad shoulders, a deep chest, planted feet. Clothing: flowing apricot silk robes with a crossed collar and a green gauze sash, wide sleeves lifting in the wind, a cape of tan and speckled brown feathers with a gold-yellow collar thrown open, borders embroidered with tiny gold birds; a jade pendant swinging at the sash. Hands and objects: her right arm thrust up in a fine gauntlet, a small brown bird hovering at the wrist; the left hand pressed against her breastbone. Power: her voice sends a faint ring of green qi rippling outward and pale motes follow the birds in a spiral. Background: a dark violet dusk sky shot with rose, a ridge in mist, birds as dark specks. Light: low rosy-gold spirit-light from the upper left, rose-gold edges rimming every windblown strand of hair. Expression: a bold, glowing, open-throated joy, chin high and eyes half shut, entirely certain that the sky was made to hear her.

people.imagined: Reading over his master's shoulder in the post-house, trying to look as if he is not. His left ear, always pink from the sun, is turned toward the page like a dish.
people.subject: The moment: in a post-house, a young man leans on a doorframe with his arms folded, his head tilted so that his left ear points toward something unseen, his eyes sliding sideways at the viewer. Face (most important: the permanently pink ear): a narrow, pale, guarded face; his left ear is a strong, bright sunburnt pink, much redder than the rest of his skin, and sticks out clearly; narrow grey-brown eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; thin lips tight in a half-smile. A faint shine of sweat sits at his temple, and a small mole shows beneath the right eye. Hair: black, combed flat and tied low with a slate-green ribbon and a plain jade pin. Body: wiry, medium height, shoulders slightly forward. Clothing: a clean slate-green silk robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves folded over his arms, a short dark-brown feather mantle with a collar of blue-grey feathers, collar embroidered with tiny gold birds; a wide sash with a small brass buckle and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a brown post bird on his folded forearm, a fine riding glove on the other hand tucked in his armpit. Power: a thin faint thread of green qi runs from his pink ear toward the door, as if listening. Background: a dark wall of small wooden pigeonholes stacked with rolled slips climbs behind him in mist, an out-of-focus lamp. Light: cool white spirit-light from a window at upper left, hard on the pink ear, a silver rim on his hair. Expression: a thin, closed half-smile with the eyes sliding sideways, the careful blankness of a man who is reading what he was not asked to read.

people.imagined: A raft-village cage-maker sitting at his bench weaving, swaying slightly with the memory of water even on dry land, charging double for what he was told not to ask about.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stool at a weaving bench in blue dusk, an old man holds a half-woven wicker cage frame and sways gently from side to side, as if on a raft, eyes on his own hands. Face: a long, weathered face the colour of old rope; deep vertical wrinkles; a drooping grey moustache; small, shrewd, pale-brown eyes with heavy lids; a long straight nose; a thin, closed mouth with a tight sly corner. Hair: thin grey hair tied in a short queue, a river-blue headcloth knotted on top. Body: lean and wiry, bent forward, long strong fingers, sinewy forearms. Clothing: he is a servant, not a keeper, so no feather mantle: a plain but clean undyed hemp-silk jacket with crossed collar and wide sleeves, the cuffs dyed river-blue, a woven reed belt; simple and tidy, no ornaments. Hands and objects: a half-woven cage of pale reeds with nine ribs, one cut reed held in his teeth; a bundle of cut reeds on his lap; a small iron knife with a bone handle tucked behind his ear. Power: none beyond a faint dull steel-grey glint of metal qi on the knife. Background: a dark workshop in mist, finished cages hanging, bundles of cane, a slice of green water light. Light: soft grey-blue spirit-light from the upper left, a faint silver rim on his moustache. Expression: reclusive, pragmatic, money-minded; a man who has decided his silence is worth double.

people.imagined: The founder, old, high on Triều Phượng Đỉnh at dawn, as he climbs every spring. He stands with his staff and looks down the slope at the birds in the wind below, waiting to see whether they bow.
people.subject: The moment: a weathered old founder stands on a summit at dawn leaning on a staff, gazing out and slightly down to his right with an expression of hope; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: long, lean, brown, deeply lined; a long white beard to mid-chest, thin and wispy; shaggy white brows over keen pale eyes; a high forehead; a gentle, slightly open mouth. Weather has chapped his cheekbones to a deep brown and fine white hairs grow along the edges of his ears. Hair: long white hair worn loose, held by a crown-band of plaited bark set with one jade bead and a single feather. Body: tall, rangy, narrow, leaning on a staff taller than he is. Clothing: the founder's richest robes: layered long robes of leaf-green and russet silk with three crossed collars, wide trailing sleeves, a great mantle sewn all over with small moulted feathers in brown and blue that falls behind him like folded wings, gold-thread birds along every border; a rope belt hung with small carved-wood bird calls and jade pendants. Hands and objects: a tall rough wooden staff with a carved bird at its top, in both hands. Power: a faint green aura of wood qi lifts around him, with small birds like pale commas wheeling in a slow spiral above the ridge. Background: a faded pale sky, a ridge in mist. Light: low pale dawn light from the upper left; the silk-painting fade turns the whole palette to soft ochre, grey-green and bone. Expression: a tender, hopeful look, brows lifted and lips just parted, the gentle gaze of an old man waiting to see whether the birds will bow.

people.imagined: A Hà Loan netter at the edge of the dark forest with his net over his shoulder, taking one more step in, with a look of ease, as if the forest had always been kind.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a dark jungle he turns to look back with a broad trusting smile, a long net slung over one shoulder; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad square sunburnt face; thick black moustache; big warm brown eyes; heavy straight brows; a wide easy mouth. Hair: black, tied in a short topknot with a green silk cord. A few grey strands show at the temples and a short fringe has escaped onto his forehead. Body: broad, muscular, a middle-aged netter's frame. Clothing: a grey-green silk shirt with a crossed collar and rolled sleeves, a russet sash, over it a sleeveless jerkin of tough hide as a netter's work-coat, the only plain thing about him; no feather mantle. Hands and objects: a long fine net rolled over his left shoulder with a few bright green parrot feathers caught in it; in his right hand a short wooden pole with a hook. Power: a few soft green motes of wood qi drift among the leaves near him, gentle and faint. Background: a faded dark green wall of tall trees in layers, a single shaft of pale light on one trunk, a curl of mist along the ground. Light: soft low spirit-light from the upper left, a little warm. Expression: content, brave, trusting, unafraid; no fear at all, only the open ease of a man to whom the forest has always been kind.
